verdict.rationale: Elastic markets an AI SRE ('nightshift') that detects and investigates incidents and delivers an evidence-backed root cause, which directly matches the story. This is backed by documented root-cause surfacing and natural-language interaction with telemetry. The evidence is marketing-level only, with no in-depth docs or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on triggering AI investigation from a specific alert or error, a description of the investigation workflow and output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have the platform's AI investigate an alert or error and propose a probable root cause

citations.quote: Elastic nightshift AI SRE detects and investigates incidents, delivering evidence-backed root cause.
the ability to surface correlations and root causes
Interact directly with your telemetry through natural language and resolve problems faster
